intents.title: Immigrant-led community capital
intents.statement: Help immigrants and underserved communities combine knowledge, relationships, skills, and governed capital to own productive assets.
intents.intended_outcome: Participant capability and productive ownership increase.
intents.next_review_trigger: Any product direction that does not improve productive capability.

intents.title: Productive value only
intents.statement: Returns must come from cash flow, service, infrastructure, business improvement, or fundamentals, never engineered price movement.
intents.intended_outcome: No hidden transfer of losses to later participants.
intents.next_review_trigger: Any coordinated-buy, promotion, fake-volume, or coordinated-exit feature.

intents.title: Simulation-first launch
intents.statement: Begin in simulation and advance only through explicit evidence-gated stages.
intents.intended_outcome: Prove mechanics before exposing people or capital.

intents.title: Organized agent collaboration
intents.statement: Agents collaborate through typed roles, preserve dissent, and produce attributable proposals without creating authority through agreement.
intents.next_review_trigger: The multi-agent workflow fails to beat a simpler baseline.

intents.title: Human constitutional authority
intents.statement: Models reason, agents propose, authorized humans decide, and only the UNIIMENTE Kernel may permit external consequences.
intents.intended_outcome: Capability never becomes independent legal or financial authority.

intents.title: Zero-trust capability control
intents.statement: Every actor is identified, narrowly authorized, expiring, revocable, and attributable.
intents.intended_outcome: No ambient authority or single-component control of capital.
conflicts: Development header roles are not production authentication

intents.title: Selective blockchain use
intents.statement: Use blockchain for shared proof, identity, governance, escrow, and settlement, not as the application database or AI memory.
intents.intended_outcome: Shared verification without unnecessary cost or privacy exposure.
intents.next_review_trigger: A multi-party transaction requires a shared trust anchor.

intents.title: Productive-asset expansion
intents.statement: After proof, expand from research into founder-owned capital, productive crypto infrastructure, businesses, acquisitions, and governed Venture Cells.
intents.intended_outcome: A self-funding institution that creates real operating value.
intents.next_review_trigger: After benchmark proof and legal analysis.

intents.title: Outside capital requires legal prerequisites
intents.statement: Do not accept outside capital until legal structure, custody, valuation, administration, conflicts, eligibility, audit, and fiduciary accountability exist.
intents.intended_outcome: Software tests never substitute for legal authorization.

intents.title: Wallet proves identity only
intents.statement: Retain wallet signature verification with one-time challenges; never infer governance or financial authority from wallet control.
intents.intended_outcome: Preserve useful code without unsafe meaning.

intents.title: Protection from affinity exploitation
intents.statement: Shared immigrant identity must create multilingual capability, never pressure to invest, trust leaders, recruit, or suppress dissent.
intents.intended_outcome: Informed choice, protected dissent, and visible risk.

intents.title: One Kernel and one consequence path
intents.statement: PumpStation is a bounded Venture Cell and may not own a competing constitution, treasury sovereignty, or external-effect path.

intents.title: Proof-to-settlement closure
intents.statement: Eventually connect intelligence to authorized action, independently checkable evidence, verified outcome, settlement, reconciliation, and retained learning.
intents.intended_outcome: One clean outcome, then ten repeatable closures.
intents.next_review_trigger: A real productive-asset pilot is proposed.

intents.title: Pump-and-dump mechanisms prohibited
intents.statement: Synchronized price-moving purchases, promotion after accumulation, fake volume, deceptive scarcity, coordinated exits, and later-buyer exit liquidity are prohibited.
intents.source: Founder concept corrected through adversarial review
